plans.idea: Brand-first column: the Quillbrook badge sits centred at the top like the original, then a big three-line headline, the bag as the visual anchor, a full-width CTA, and the legal and sticker set small at the foot, all on one centre axis.

Faithful to the original's order, stretched vertically: logo, then the product, then the headline directly above its CTA so the message and the action read as one block, with the fine print at the bottom.

Headline-led skyscraper: the headline opens at the top as the dominant element, the bag and CTA follow, and the brand badge closes the column as a centred sign-off just above the small legal and sticker.
